ayahs.1: Was there not a long stretch of time when each human was nothing worth mentioning?
ayahs.2: We created humans from a mixed drop of fluid to test them, and gave them hearing and sight.
ayahs.3: We showed them the way—whether they choose shukr, gratitude in word and deed, or ingratitude.
ayahs.4: We have prepared for those who reject the truth chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.
ayahs.5: The truly virtuous will drink from a cup flavoured with camphor—
ayahs.6: from a spring where Allah's servants drink as they will.
ayahs.7: They fulfil their vows and dread a Day whose horror sweeps everything away.
ayahs.8: They feed the poor, the orphan, and the captive—even when they themselves want that food—
ayahs.9: saying, 'We feed you only for Allah's sake. We want no reward or thanks from you.
ayahs.10: We fear from our Rabb a Day of crushing distress.'
ayahs.11: Allah will shield them from that Day's horror and grant them radiance and joy,
ayahs.12: rewarding their sabr with a Garden and garments of silk.
ayahs.13: There they recline on canopied couches, untouched by scorching heat or bitter cold.
ayahs.14: Shade hangs close above them; fruit hangs within easy reach.
ayahs.15: They are served with silver vessels and crystal-clear cups—
ayahs.16: fine silver, filled exactly as desired.
ayahs.17: They are given a drink flavoured with ginger
ayahs.18: from a spring there called Salsabil.
ayahs.19: Eternal youths serve them—if you saw them you would think them scattered pearls.
ayahs.20: Look around and you would see bliss and a vast kingdom.
ayahs.21: The virtuous wear fine green silk and brocade, adorned with silver bracelets, and their Rabb gives them a purifying drink.
ayahs.22: They are told, 'All this is your reward. Your striving has been appreciated.'
ayahs.23: We revealed the Qur'an to you in stages.
ayahs.24: So be patient with your Rabb's decree, and do not obey any evildoer or staunch rejecter among them.
ayahs.25: Remember your Rabb's Name morning and evening,
ayahs.26: prostrate before Him part of the night, and glorify Him long into the night.
ayahs.27: Those who reject the truth love this fleeting world and ignore the weighty Day ahead.
ayahs.28: We created them and shaped them—and if We will, We can replace them entirely.
ayahs.29: This is a reminder. Let whoever wills take the path to their Rabb.
ayahs.30: You cannot will that unless Allah wills. He is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
ayahs.31: He admits whomever He wills into His mercy. As for wrongdoers, He has prepared painful punishment.
